title: Egypt targeted for first time, Pakistan insists US-Iran talks alive
gist: A podcast page carrying no transcript, only a one-line episode blurb: after US strikes across southern Iran, Kuwait reported a worker at a Chinese company killed and Jordan reported a fresh wave of Iranian missiles — spillover items rather than the Egypt/Pakistan headline this page is titled for.

themes.theme: Spillover from US strikes on southern Iran

insights.claim: The United States conducted strikes across southern Iran, after which Jordan reported a new wave of Iranian missiles crossing its territory.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Strikes on southern Iran — the Gulf-facing coast — plus missile waves over Jordan mark a war being fought across the Strait of Hormuz approaches and the Levant corridor at once, the two chokepoints energy and shipping risk premia key off.
insights.quote: Jordan reported a new wave of Iranian missiles after the US conducted strikes across southern Iran

insights.claim: Kuwait said a worker at a Chinese company was killed, extending the conflict's casualties to third-country commercial personnel in the Gulf states.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Chinese nationals dying on Gulf commercial sites drags Beijing from bystander toward stakeholder and raises evacuation, insurance and project-delay risk for foreign contractors across the GCC.
insights.quote: Kuwait said a worker at a Chinese company was killed
